## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Evidence

For format or decoding changes, list specifications, ROM hashes, offsets, and
independent comparisons. Do not attach files that cannot be redistributed.

## Validation

- [ ] The project builds without new warnings.
- [ ] `ctest` passes.
- [ ] Bounds checks cover every new ROM access.
- [ ] Inferred behavior is labeled as inferred.
- [ ] The input ROM remains read-only.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `CHANGELOG.md`.
